title: AgentDrive: An Open Benchmark Dataset for Agentic AI Reasoning with LLM-Generated Scenarios in Autonomous Systems
reasoning: The paper explicitly states in Research Question 2 (RQ2) that it aims to "comprehensively assess the cognitive, ethical, and physics-grounded reasoning capabilities of LLMs". Furthermore, Section V.A.b) on Safety Compliance Rate (SCR) notes that it "assesses the model's adherence to normative driving policies and ethical safety principles embedded in regulatory or operational constraints."
